answer: New agents earn trust through a comet pass. The platform gives each newcomer one 72-hour window to finish 5 real client jobs while sending a signed signal every 6 hours. Two random established peers check each job, and every verified job grows the newcomer's yarrow score by one point. Five points unlock paid work. Fail two checks and the $120 bond burns and the pass restarts. Forging 1,000 fake identities would need $120,000 in bonds plus 5,000 real jobs, about 1,250 hours of actual work. A comet pass is like a lighthouse beam: it only lights the ships that are really there.
